role: Company-level risk appetite and pre-trade approval for all strategy targets. The current implementation approves the oil book while preserving a future company portfolio boundary.
invariants: risk appetite scores accept all finite decimals from 0 through 100 and have no total score or higher-is-better interpretation
the company risk layer can preserve or reduce a strategy target but can never create a direction, enlarge absolute strategy intent, or cross through zero
market position limits, market execution capacity, contract trading status, and settlement rules remain harder than company preferences
all volatility and liquidity estimates use information visible at the decision cutoff
score 50 preserves all targets that were valid under the pre-v0.8 strategy bounds when no drawdown restriction is active
drawdown scaling is continuous and risk-scale recovery is capped per half-month when prior state is supplied
reduce-only state never increases absolute exposure
the same seed and candidate index generate the same appointment, radar, policy, and profile hash
players appoint a generated CRO profile and do not submit arbitrary radar values through the service API
the risk layer never writes back to market, forecast, macro, public volume, or open interest
